world_org_meetings.title: G20 trade ministers are meeting in Wisconsin. Many will be discussing deals without their U.S. host
world_org_meetings.description: Most of the officials attending the G20 trade ministers' meeting in Milwaukee, Wisc., find themselves in challenging positions, largely because of U.S. President Donald Trump's global tariff agenda. It makes for a potentially unusual summit, with high-level meetings on the sidelines where different countries discuss plans to work around the host.

world_org_meetings.title: Trump’s tariffs loom over talks as G20 meets in US
world_org_meetings.description: Trade ministers of the Group of 20 are meeting in Milwaukee for two days of talks on Wednesday, but US President Donald Trump’s tariffs are expected to hang heavy over the talks. "Don't expect any breakthroughs," an analyst watching the event said.

world_org_meetings.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
world_org_meetings.description: Denmark and the US have reached an agreement after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory.

world_org_meetings.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
world_org_meetings.description: The bill is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, a staunch advocate of aid for Ukraine.

world_org_meetings.title: The new lines of southern Lebanon
world_org_meetings.description: The U.N. expanded the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon's mandate 20 years ago to include monitoring adherence to a ceasefire in fighting between Israel and Lebanon's Iran-backed Hezbollah — the militant group created in 1982 to counter a second Israeli invasion.

diplomatic_visits.title: UAE confirms president met with Israel's PM Netanyahu in Abu Dhabi on Sunday
diplomatic_visits.description: The visit came weeks after a bombshell Israeli media report that the Emirati president had warned Netanyahu ahead of the Hamas-led attack on Israel in 2023, which the Israeli premier did not pass on to the security services.

diplomatic_visits.title: Macron says UK’s return to EU would be ‘excellent news’
diplomatic_visits.description: Speaking alongside Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez on Wednesday, French President Emmanuel Macron said that it would be "a good decision" if the UK decided to rejoin the European Union. The two leaders met at the Moncloa Palace in Madrid on the second day of Macron's two-day state visit to Spain.

diplomatic_visits.title: Attention turns to economy on final day of Macron’s visit to Spain
diplomatic_visits.description: President Emmanuel Macron is in Spain for the final day of his two-day state visit, the first by a French president to the country since 2009. After being welcomed with a banquet at the Royal Palace by King Felipe VI on Tuesday, on today's agenda is the opening of the Franco-Spanish economic forum and a meeting with Spain's leftist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez. Once economically ahead of Spain, France is now seeing Spain grow faster, as the Spanish economy has outpaced its French neighbour in recent years.

diplomatic_visits.title: Three takeaways from Trump's 'Super Intelligence' summit
diplomatic_visits.description: The president also signed an executive order requiring his government to refer to AI as Super Intelligence.

diplomatic_visits.title: Trump offered to sell arms to China during Xi visit, US ambassador tells Fox News
diplomatic_visits.description: The United States is required by law to supply Taiwan, which has a democratically elected president and legislature, with weapons for its defence under the 1979 Taiwan Relations Act.

elections.title: Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babiš’s government survives no-confidence vote
elections.description: The Czech government led by populist billionaire Andrej Babiš survives a parliamentary no-confidence vote

elections.title: Haiti struggles with rise in kidnappings as general election looms
elections.description: Kidnappings are on the rise across Haiti

elections.title: Latvians head to the polls with Russia on their minds
elections.description: On October 3, Latvians will elect a new parliament with Russia looming large over the campaign. Security fears dominate the agenda, but so does a debate over the economic cost of cutting ties with Moscow.

elections.title: Why Brazil's gun lobby is backing Bolsonaro as country heads to polls
elections.description: As Brazil heads to the polls, one issue that could influence votes particularly in the rural south is access to firearms. Under Jair Bolsonaro, Brazil became more heavily armed than ever before: the number of registered hunters, shooters and collectors – known by the acronym ‘CACs’ – increased sevenfold in four years. Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva promised to reverse this trend, much to the irritation of the powerful gun lobby. France 24’s team in Brazil sent this report.

elections.title: French website publishes evidence for antisemitism claims against Bardella
elections.description: French investigative journalism website Mediapart said Thursday it had been able to authenticate antisemitic messages from 2013 attributed to far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen's de facto deputy Jordan Bardella. The allegations come just seven months out from the election where voters will choose a replacement for President Emmanuel Macron, with Le Pen leading opinion polls.
